integrity: Proof by explicit combinatorial Alexander-dual collapse, exact chain characters, sign-twisted duality, and finite-group averaging; standalone exact rational examples are supplementary rather than a substitute for the all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology and translation actions only, with both cyclic lengths at least five; no claim about integral quotient torsion, quotient homotopy, or other automorphisms.
title: Translation-parity homology of ordinary three-cut complexes on toroidal grids
